demo.title: Ising machine finds the min cut
demo.code: const w=[[0,3,1],[3,0,2],[1,2,0]];let best=1e9;for(let m=1;m<7;m++){const s=[0,1,2].map(i=>(m>>i)&1?1:-1);let cut=0;for(let i=0;i<3;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<3;j++)if(s[i]!==s[j])cut+=w[i][j];if(cut<best)best=cut;}J({min_cut:best});assert(best===3,'ising');

demo.title: Quantization error shrinks with bits
demo.code: function err(bits){const q=Math.pow(2,bits);let e=0;for(let i=0;i<100;i++){const x=i/100;e+=Math.pow(x-Math.round(x*q)/q,2);}return e;}const e4=err(4),e8=err(8);J({e4:+e4.toFixed(4),e8:+e8.toFixed(5)});assert(e8<e4,'quant');
